rules.title: General prohibition on local rent control; exception
rules.requirement: No city or town may enact, maintain or enforce rent control of any kind. A city or town that accepts Chapter 40P may adopt rent control only if compliance becomes voluntary after six months, the regulation does not cover evictions or other listed matters, it excludes owners with fewer than ten rental units and units with fair market rent over $400, and the municipality compensates owners from general funds.
rules.key_value: No city or town may enact, maintain or enforce rent control of any kind
rules.coverage_text: All cities and towns in Massachusetts; limits any local rent control regulation.
rules.exemptions: A city or town that accepts this chapter may adopt rent control regulation that: becomes entirely voluntary for property owners after six months from initial adoption; does not regulate occupancy, services, evictions, condominium conversion or removal of properties from regulation; does not apply to units owned by a person or entity owning less than ten rental units or with a fair market rent exceeding $400; and compensates owners from the municipality's general funds for the difference between fair market rent and the rent controlled rent.
rules.citation: General Law - Part I, Title VII, Chapter 40P, Section 4
